nuggets.text: Owen McCown is the son of former NFL quarterback Josh McCown.
Owen McCown, a lefty, is the only three-year starting quarterback in the American Conference.
The Roadrunners have 99 all-time wins, so a victory in San Marcos would be program win No. 100.
The Roadrunners' first-ever game, in 2011, drew 56,743 fans, a record for an FBS startup program.
Jeff Traylor's 2021 Roadrunners won their first 11 games, the best start in program history.
The Roadrunners are 34-5 at the Alamodome since 2020.
Jeff Traylor has produced six winning seasons in six years at UTSA.
Owen McCown set a UTSA record with 434 passing yards against Tulsa in 2024.
